activity.overview: Listen to the clues shape detectives use. Then answer the questions.
activity.passage: Shape detectives look for clues. A triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is closed, with no gaps. A big triangle and a tiny triangle are both triangles. A red triangle and a blue triangle are both triangles. Color and size do not change the shape. Sides and corners do!

questions.prompt: How many sides does a triangle have?
Does color change what shape it is? Tell why.
A square has 4 sides that are all the same length. Is a long, skinny rectangle a square? Tell why.
Draw a triangle that looks different from your friend's. Is it still a triangle?

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: What Makes a Shape?
